AI tool directory

Picking the right tool for the scenario beats chasing every new release

At the top are this site's own free tools (cost calculator, model library, comparison tool, rank test and prompt library). Below, mainstream third-party AI tools are grouped into chat / image / video / coding / office categories, each with its pricing model, typical use cases and a direct official-site link, verified periodically. Hands-on guides for wiring tools into business workflows — including automation and cost analysis — are in the guides.
